headline: 2-year yield rises to highest since January 2025 after hot jobs report boosts expectations that the Fed could raise rates
detail: Higher interest rates typically hurt growth stocks and tech names, as future earnings are discounted more heavily. For your leveraged positions, this market sentiment amplifies potential drawdowns.
rec: Review your leveraged positions like SOXL and SPAL. Consider trimming to reduce exposure to rate-sensitive assets, especially with margin.
